text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience working with data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

I know this job is about more than making calls—it’s about qualifying leads accurately, understanding what matters to each prospect, and helping the sales team focus their time where it counts. That’s the kind of organized, detail-oriented work I’m comfortable with. I’m used to working through large sets of information, spotting patterns, and keeping records clear and reliable so decisions can be made quickly and confidently.

One relevant project I completed was an HR attrition dashboard for a confidential manufacturing client. I built an attrition and absence dashboard in Power BI, Excel, and SQL, with access tailored so each plant manager could only see their own plant. The dashboard covered 1,900 employees and helped surface attrition hotspots in 2 plants. That project reinforced the importance of clean data, careful filtering, and presenting information in a way that supports action—skills that carry over well to lead qualification and sales support.

While my background is centered on data, the same strengths apply here: consistency, follow-through, attention to detail, and the ability to work through a process methodically. I’m comfortable handling repetitive work accurately, tracking information carefully, and keeping the pipeline organized so the team can move faster with better information.

If you’re looking for someone dependable who can support your sales process with focus and professionalism, I’d be glad to discuss how I can help. I’d appreciate the opportunity to contribute to your team and support your lead qualification efforts.
